title: wwwcw-intercontinental-heavyweight
label: Iceman

won.source: Pinned champion Shooter at Hog Wild 97 (/promotions/wwwcw/archive/wwwcw-hog-wild-1997-11-08.html), with interference from both the Wolf Pack and the Foundation.

how: Pinfall, after both the Wolf Pack (War Dog) and the Foundation (Mr. Moneybags) interfered against the champion.

title: wwwcw-us-heavyweight
label: War Dog

won.source: Named the new United States Heavyweight Champion by the ring announcer immediately after losing the Intercontinental title match to Fredo at On Your Screen (/promotions/wwwcw/archive/wwwcw-on-your-screen-1997-11-08.html).

how: Awarded on the same night, not won in a title match of its own.

won.source: Last man standing in a five-man Chicken Coop weapons match at Hog Wild 97 (/promotions/wwwcw/archive/wwwcw-hog-wild-1997-11-08.html), introducing the title.

title: wwwcw-alliance-championship
label: The Foundation

won.source: Won the five-man stable-war survival match at Alliance Armageddon (/promotions/wwwcw/archive/wwwcw-alliance-armageddon-1997-11-08.html) when a masked interloper, unmasked as roster member Will Womack, turned on the Wolf Pack.

how: Five-man tag survival match; last man (Bushwhacker) pinned the Wolf Pack's Death Wolf.
